mapper.select: select (select count(*) from biz_elderly where status = '0') as elderlyTotal, (select count(*) from iot_device where status = '0') as onlineDeviceTotal, (select count(*) from biz_alert_record where date(create_time) = curdate()) as todayAlertTotal, (select count(*) from biz_alert_record where alert_level = 2 and date(create_time) = curdate()) as urgentAlertTotal, (select count(*) from biz_work_order where status in ('0', '1')) as pendingOrderTotal, (select count(*) from biz_visit_record where visit_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 7 day)) as weekVisitTotal, (select count(*) from biz_health_report) as reportTotal
select cast(alert_level as char) as value, count(*) as count from biz_alert_record group by alert_level order by alert_level
select status as value, count(*) as count from iot_device group by status order by status

select e.elderly_id as elderlyId, e.elderly_name as elderlyName, e.address as address, e.phone as phone, ifnull((select count(*) from iot_device d where d.elderly_id = e.elderly_id), 0) as deviceCount, ifnull((select count(*) from iot_device d where d.elderly_id = e.elderly_id and d.status = '0'), 0) as onlineDeviceCount, ifnull((select count(*) from biz_alert_record ar where ar.elderly_id = e.elderly_id), 0) as alertCount, ifnull((select count(*) from biz_work_order wo where wo.elderly_id = e.elderly_id and wo.status in ('0', '1')), 0) as pendingOrderCount, ( select cast(ar.alert_level as char) from biz_alert_record ar where ar.elderly_id = e.elderly_id order by ar.create_time desc limit 1 ) as latestAlertLevel, ( select ar.create_time from biz_alert_record ar where ar.elderly_id = e.elderly_id order by ar.create_time desc limit 1 ) as latestAlertTime, ( select round((ifnull(hr.sleep_score, 0) + ifnull(hr.activity_score, 0)) / 2) from biz_health_report hr where hr.elderly_id = e.elderly_id order by hr.report_date desc, hr.report_id desc limit 1 ) as latestHealthScore, ( select vr.visit_time from biz_visit_record vr where vr.elderly_id = e.elderly_id order by vr.visit_time desc, vr.record_id desc limit 1 ) as latestVisitTime from biz_elderly e where e.status = '0' order by pendingOrderCount desc, alertCount desc, latestAlertTime desc limit 8

select ar.alert_id as alertId, ar.elderly_id as elderlyId, ar.elderly_name as elderlyName, cast(ar.alert_level as char) as alertLevel, ar.alert_type as alertType, ar.handle_status as handleStatus, ar.alert_desc as alertDesc, ar.create_time as createTime from biz_alert_record ar order by ar.create_time desc, ar.alert_id desc limit 6

select wo.order_id as orderId, wo.alert_id as alertId, wo.elderly_id as elderlyId, wo.elderly_name as elderlyName, wo.status as status, wo.process_record as processRecord, wo.create_time as createTime from biz_work_order wo where wo.status in ('0', '1') order by wo.create_time desc, wo.order_id desc limit 6

select hr.report_id as reportId, hr.elderly_id as elderlyId, hr.elderly_name as elderlyName, hr.report_type as reportType, hr.report_date as reportDate, hr.sleep_score as sleepScore, hr.activity_score as activityScore, round((ifnull(hr.sleep_score, 0) + ifnull(hr.activity_score, 0)) / 2) as totalScore, hr.ai_evaluation as aiEvaluation from biz_health_report hr order by hr.report_date desc, hr.report_id desc limit 6
